intro.title: NovaVault: Residential Modular Power System
intro.description: NovaVault is a compact, intelligent Modular Power System designed for residential applications. Store solar energy during the day and use it at night, reduce peak-hour electricity costs, and ensure your home stays powered during outages. With seamless solar integration and smart energy management, NovaVault gives you complete control over your household energy consumption.

features.title: Peak Shaving
features.description: Reduce electricity bills by up to 50% through intelligent load shifting during peak-rate hours.

features.title: Backup Power
features.description: Seamless automatic switchover during outages - keep your home running 24/7.

features.title: Solar Integration
features.description: Maximize solar investment by storing excess energy for use after sunset.

features.title: Smart Management
features.description: Monitor and control energy usage in real-time through our intuitive app.

features.title: Eco-Friendly

features.title: Energy Security
